name: workmanager-vscode
description: Tracks the active terminal's working directory for the Work Manager time tracker.

workManager.outputPath.description: Absolute path to write the active terminal CWD to. Leave empty to use ~/.wm_vscode_cwd (or %USERPROFILE%\.wm_vscode_cwd on Windows).

workManager.updateWindowTitle.description: Inject the active terminal CWD into the VS Code window title so Work Manager can read it directly.

workManager.titleFormat.description: Window title format. Use ${cwdBasename} or ${cwd} for terminal working directory.

workManager.updateIntervalMs.description: How often to refresh the active terminal CWD (milliseconds).

commands.title: Work Manager: Update terminal CWD now
